title: AuthenticationEvaluated
description: An authentication attempt was evaluated. Carries a subject reference only when the principal was recognised: a failure against an unknown principal has no subject to name, which is why `subject_ref` is optional here. No network or device identifiers: they would re-identify across the pseudonym boundary and the operational stream does not need them to be useful.

subject_ref.description: Pairwise pseudonym of the data subject. Subject authenticated. Absent when the principal was not recognised, or when the principal is not a natural person.

principal_kind.description: What kind of principal attempted to authenticate. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

outcome.description: Result of the evaluation. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

method.description: Authentication method presented. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

session_id.description: Session established on success. Random, and not derivable from the subject.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
